experiment_data.hypothesis: Full-dataset discriminative rate analysis (W1+W3 合并): Qwen2.5-14B 在 804 题上 self-extracted constraints 的 source-trace discriminativeness 和 Z3 semantic discriminativeness 均低于 15%，证明即使用 Z3 per-answer evaluation，self-extracted constraints 仍无判别力，封堵 oracle scoring confound。
experiment_data.notes: Full 804-instance discriminative rate analysis (R3 W1+W3). Source-trace disc (by weight): 38.6% [38.0, 39.1], pilot 验证 37.0% vs 报告 37.2% (差 0.2pp)。Z3 semantic disc: 仅 8.2% [7.6, 8.8]——642/7844 unique constraints 含 answer assertion 变量，92% 对任何候选答案语义等价。Per-domain: FOLIO 53.1% > ProofWriter 35.8%。284/307 multi-candidate 问题有至少 1 个 discriminative constraint (92.5%)，但整体权重占比低。注意：full dataset 的 raw_constraints 文本未持久化，weight-based rate 通过代数方法从 scorer 输出推导 (D_w = 2*TW - Σ(sica_scores))。v2 Worker 正在尝试 by-count rate 计算。
